patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports a 2-month history of persistent fatigue and several episodes of lower abdominal pain. Despite being on sick leave for 2 weeks, symptoms have not improved. She expresses a concern that she might have cancer and requests a diagnostic laparoscopy. She was diagnosed with peptic ulcer disease 6 months ago.
patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Diagnosed with peptic ulcer disease 6 months prior, currently taking omeprazole.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Works as a nurse, has been under a lot of stress at work.

Review_of_Systems.Skin: Numerous crusts along the left arm veins
Review_of_Systems.Cardiovascular: Grade 2/6 systolic ejection murmur along the right-upper sternal border
Review_of_Systems.Musculoskeletal: Generalized weakness of the proximal muscles

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and manage a patient presenting with fatigue, episodes of lower abdominal pain, and a self-stated high cancer concern.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today, and could you tell me about yourself and what’s been going on? Patient: I’m a 26-year-old nurse, and for about two months I’ve had persistent fatigue and I’ve noticed paleness. I’ve also had a few episodes of lower abdominal pain, and despite being off work for two weeks on sick leave, I’m not improving. I’ve been under a lot of stress and I’m worried it could be cancer, so I wanted to ask about whether I need further diagnostic testing like laparoscopy.

turns.doctor_question: you been experiencing a sudden and urgent need to urinate lately, even when your bladder isn't full
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t had a sudden urgent need to urinate or any urinary urgency—I’ve mainly been dealing with persistent fatigue and paleness, plus a few episodes of lower abdominal pain. I’ve also felt quite weak in my proximal muscles and my mood’s been low due to the ongoing symptoms.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a firm lump or mass in your breast that doesn't seem to go away, or have you had one that you've been concerned about?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any firm breast lump or mass, and I’m not particularly concerned about my breasts. My main issues have been persistent fatigue with paleness, occasional lower abdominal pain, and generalized proximal muscle weakness, along with a lot of work stress.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any small, firm bumps on your skin that are smooth to the touch?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed small, firm smooth bumps on my skin; instead, I’ve had numerous crusts along the veins of my left arm and I’m feeling generally run down. I’m mostly concerned that I’m not getting better and I want to know what tests I should have next.

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling about your body temperature lately? Have you noticed that you're having trouble cooling down, even when you're resting in a cool place or not doing much of anything?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any trouble cooling down or persistent fevers—I’ve mainly just felt very run down, pale, and fatigued for the last two months. The main change is worsening weakness and a few episodes of lower abdominal pain, despite being on sick leave.”

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling lately? Have you been experiencing a lot of stress or anxiety in your daily life?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: Yes, I’ve been under a lot of stress at work and I do feel very anxious about what’s happening, especially because I’m not improving on sick leave. I’m also quite depressed and worried I might have something serious like cancer.

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching sensations on your skin lately, either all over or in specific areas?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I haven’t noticed any itching all over or in specific areas—mostly I’ve just had those crusts along the left arm veins, persistent fatigue with paleness, and generalized weakness. I’m mainly anxious because I’m not improving even after two weeks off work.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on your arms?
turns.patient_answer: Doctor: Have you noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on your arms? Patient: Yes—I've had numerous crusts along the veins on my left arm, and they don’t seem to be settling. I’ve mainly been focusing on my persistent fatigue and paleness, but those skin changes have been bothering me too.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that it's been harder to find the right words when you're talking or thinking lately?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any trouble finding the right words, confusion, or problems thinking clearly—I’ve mainly had persistent fatigue with paleness, generalized proximal muscle weakness, and those crusts along the veins on my left arm, plus a few episodes of lower abdominal pain. I’m feeling very anxious and depressed because I’m not improving on sick leave. What tests should I have next?”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any stiffness or inflexibility in your muscles, like feeling hard to move or bend your arms or legs?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I haven’t noticed any stiffness or trouble bending my arms or legs, but I do feel generalized weakness, especially in the proximal muscles. I’m more concerned that I’m not improving despite sick leave, and I’d like to know what tests I should have next to rule out something serious.

turns.doctor_question: How are you feeling today in terms of your energy levels and alertness? Do you feel unusually sleepy or drowsy?
turns.patient_answer: “Today I feel quite exhausted and unusually tired—I’m not drowsy, but my energy is very low and I’m not feeling alert like I normally do. I’m also still worried because I haven’t improved despite being off work for two weeks.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel that one or both of your legs are unusually warm right now, or do they feel about the same temperature as the rest of your body?

My main ongoing problems are the persistent fatigue with paleness, generalized proximal muscle weakness, and those crusts along the veins on my left arm.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you find that you're coughing up mucus or phlegm, or is your cough mostly dry?

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that are rough and scaly, perhaps feeling a bit like dry patches or feeling itchy?

turns.doctor_question: you noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or growths on your skin that don't hurt or cause discomfort when touched?
